summary: Adopt site-local canonical My Pages as the default post-login destination for EKODI user and independent sites, while retaining /my as the platform-wide personal/cross-site home and keeping authorization in canonical Person + Workspace + Role + Capability boundaries.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly confirmed the Site-Local Member Home Contract and instructed EKODI to proceed on 2026-09-20.
policy: Successful site login returns to the current site's canonical My Page rather than the global /my home.
New person, organization, business, church, community and store subjects receive an eager registry-live experience foundation.
Core/Common/Specialist capabilities are projected from current registries and Workspace Packs rather than copied into per-user authorization rows.
Site-specific personalization is presentation-only and cannot grant or remove RBAC authority.
Future compatible services and capabilities inherit through the current registries without per-user catalog migrations.
authorityImpact: No autonomous authority expansion. RBAC, immutable workspace identity and private-data boundaries remain the authorization source of truth; My Page preferences are presentation-only.
dataImpact: Adds additive foundation and presentation-preference records. No existing private service data is copied across workspaces and no provider becomes an identity or authorization authority.
rollout: CI -> isolated Shared Site staging -> Supabase migration validation -> guarded production promotion -> real route and login-return verification.
rollback: Revert the site-local member-home routing/UI release and additive policy changes through the guarded pipeline. Keep canonical membership and identity records intact. If database rollback is required, stop writes to the new preference/foundation tables first, revert application use, then remove only the additive objects after verifying no dependent release remains.
